---
pagetitle: "`r if (nchar(params$committee_name) > 0) params$committee_name else params$CMTE_ID`"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
    toc: true
    toc-location: right
    toc-depth: 2

params:
  CMTE_ID: "C00401224"   # default: Chuck Grassley for Senate (example)
  committee_name: ""     # optional display name; auto-populated by render.R
---

```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), here("data/campaign_finance/campaign_finance.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE)

comm_meta <- tbl(con, "fec_committees") |>
  filter(CMTE_ID == params$CMTE_ID) |>
  collect()

comm_stats <- tbl(con, "fec_committee_summary") |>
  filter(CMTE_ID == params$CMTE_ID) |>
  collect()

by_year <- tbl(con, "fec_committee_year") |>
  filter(CMTE_ID == params$CMTE_ID) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type))

by_donor <- tbl(con, "fec_committee_donor") |>
  filter(CMTE_ID == params$CMTE_ID) |>
  collect()

all_contributions <- tbl(con, "fec_contributions") |>
  filter(CMTE_ID == params$CMTE_ID) |>
  select(date, cycle, donor_display, donor_type,
         CITY, STATE, EMPLOYER, OCCUPATION,
         contribution_amount, TRANSACTION_TP) |>
  arrange(desc(date)) |>
  collect()

dbDisconnect(con)

has_meta          <- nrow(comm_meta) > 0
has_contributions <- nrow(comm_stats) > 0

display_name <- if (nchar(params$committee_name) > 0) {
  params$committee_name
} else if (has_contributions) {
  comm_stats$committee_name[1]
} else if (has_meta) {
  comm_meta$committee_name[1]
} else {
  params$CMTE_ID
}
```

# `r display_name`

```{r}
#| output: asis
ci <- if (has_contributions) comm_stats[1, ] else NULL
mi <- if (has_meta) comm_meta[1, ] else NULL

show_field <- function(label, val) {
  if (!is.null(val) && !is.na(val) && nchar(as.character(val)) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("**%s:** %s  \n", label, val))
}

src <- if (!is.null(ci)) ci else mi

if (!is.null(src)) {
  show_field("Candidate",    src$candidate_name)
  show_field("Party",        src$party)
  show_field("Office",       src$office)
  show_field("District",     src$office_district)
  show_field("Election Year", src$election_year)
} else {
  cat("\n*Committee not found in FEC records.*\n")
}
cat(sprintf("**FEC Committee ID:** %s  \n", params$CMTE_ID))
```

---

## Summary

### Contributions Received

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  cs <- comm_stats[1, ]
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Total Raised", "Number of Transactions", "Unique Donors",
      "Average Contribution", "Earliest Contribution", "Latest Contribution"
    ),
    Value = c(
      dollar(cs$total_raised),
      comma(cs$n_transactions),
      comma(cs$n_unique_donors),
      dollar(cs$avg_contribution),
      format(as.Date(cs$first_contribution), "%B %d, %Y"),
      format(as.Date(cs$last_contribution),  "%B %d, %Y")
    )
  )
  gt(summary_df) |>
    cols_label(Metric = "", Value = "") |>
    tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("No contribution data found for this committee.\n")
}
```

### Top Donors

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  top_n <- min(10, nrow(by_donor))
  by_donor |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    slice_head(n = top_n) |>
    mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)) |>
    select(donor_display, donor_type, city, state, total, transactions) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      donor_display = "Donor",
      donor_type    = "Type",
      city          = "City",
      state         = "State",
      total         = "Total Given",
      transactions  = "Transactions"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_integer(columns = transactions) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

### Donor Type Breakdown

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  grand_total <- sum(by_donor$total, na.rm = TRUE)

  by_donor |>
    mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)) |>
    group_by(donor_type) |>
    summarize(
      total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
      donors       = n(),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(pct = total / grand_total) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      donor_type   = "Donor Type",
      total        = "Total Given",
      pct          = "Share",
      transactions = "Transactions",
      donors       = "Unique Donors"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_percent(columns = pct, decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_integer(columns = c(transactions, donors)) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Contributions Over Time

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  totals_by_year <- by_year |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(totals_by_year, aes(x = year, y = total)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2C5F8A") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty()) +
    labs(title = "Contributions Received by Year", x = NULL, y = "Total Amount") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  by_year_type <- by_year |>
    filter(donor_type %in% c("Individual", "Organization"))

  if (nrow(by_year_type) > 0) {
    ggplot(by_year_type, aes(x = year, y = total, fill = donor_type)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty()) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Individual" = "#2C5F8A", "Organization" = "#E07B2A")) +
      labs(
        title = "Contributions by Donor Type", x = NULL, y = "Total Amount",
        fill  = "Donor Type"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")
  }
}
```

## Donor Geography

### Contributions by State

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  grand_total <- sum(by_donor$total, na.rm = TRUE)

  by_state <- by_donor |>
    filter(!is.na(state), nchar(state) > 0) |>
    group_by(state) |>
    summarize(
      total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
      donors       = n(),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(pct = total / grand_total)

  by_state |>
    slice_head(n = 20) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      state        = "State",
      total        = "Total Given",
      pct          = "Share",
      transactions = "Transactions",
      donors       = "Unique Donors"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_percent(columns = pct, decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_integer(columns = c(transactions, donors)) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

### Iowa Donors

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

iowa_cities_agg <- by_donor |>
  filter(state == "IA", !is.na(city), nchar(city) > 0) |>
  group_by(city) |>
  summarize(
    total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
    transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
    donors       = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(city_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(city)))

if (nrow(iowa_cities_agg) > 0) {
  ia_counties <- counties(state = "IA", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE)
  ia_places   <- places(state = "IA", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
    mutate(city_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(NAME))) |>
    st_centroid()

  city_pts <- ia_places |>
    inner_join(iowa_cities_agg, by = "city_upper")

  if (nrow(city_pts) > 0) {
    county_totals <- city_pts |>
      st_join(ia_counties |> select(county = NAME)) |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      group_by(county) |>
      summarize(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    county_map <- ia_counties |>
      left_join(county_totals, by = c("NAME" = "county"))

    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = county_map, aes(fill = total), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_sf(data = city_pts, aes(size = total), color = "#FF8C00", alpha = 0.75) +
      scale_fill_gradient(
        low = "#D6E8F5", high = "#0D3A5C",
        na.value = "gray92",
        labels = dollar_format(),
        name = "County Total"
      ) +
      scale_size_continuous(
        range = c(1, 9), labels = dollar_format(), name = "City Total"
      ) +
      labs(title = "Contributions from Iowa Donors") +
      theme_void(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right"
      )
  } else {
    cat("No Iowa donor cities could be matched to geographic locations.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No Iowa donor data available.\n")
}
```

## Employers & Occupations

```{r}
# Filter out entries that don't represent a real employer affiliation
non_employers <- c(
  "RETIRED", "SELF-EMPLOYED", "SELF EMPLOYED", "NOT EMPLOYED",
  "NONE", "N/A", "NA", "HOMEMAKER", "STUDENT", "UNEMPLOYED",
  "INFORMATION REQUESTED", "INFORMATION REQUESTED PER BEST EFFORTS"
)

employer_agg <- all_contributions |>
  filter(
    !is.na(EMPLOYER),
    !str_to_upper(str_trim(EMPLOYER)) %in% non_employers,
    nchar(str_trim(EMPLOYER)) > 0
  ) |>
  mutate(employer_clean = str_to_title(str_squish(EMPLOYER))) |>
  group_by(employer_clean) |>
  summarize(
    total        = sum(contribution_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    donors       = n_distinct(donor_display),
    transactions = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total))
```

## All Contributions

```{r}
#| output: asis
max_rows <- 1000L
n_total  <- nrow(all_contributions)
if (n_total > max_rows)
  cat(sprintf(
    "*Showing the %s most recent of %s total transactions.*\n\n",
    scales::comma(max_rows), scales::comma(n_total)
  ))
```

```{r}
if (nrow(all_contributions) > 0) {
  all_contributions |>
    slice_head(n = max_rows) |>
    mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)) |>
    select(date, cycle, donor_display, donor_type,
           CITY, STATE, contribution_amount, TRANSACTION_TP) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      date                = "Date",
      cycle               = "Cycle",
      donor_display       = "Donor",
      donor_type          = "Type",
      CITY                = "City",
      STATE               = "State",
      contribution_amount = "Amount",
      TRANSACTION_TP      = "Transaction Type"
    ) |>
    fmt_date(columns = date, date_style = "yMMMd") |>
    fmt_currency(columns = contribution_amount, currency = "USD") |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(11))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```
